newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Alcorn seeks oil jv with Petronas unit.
newsitem.headline: Alcorn seeks oil jv with Petronas unit.

text.p: Philippine oil explorer Alcorn Petroleum & Minerals Corp (APMC) said on Wednesday it is seeking a joint venture with Petronas Carigali for the exploration of the offshore Agusan-Davao basin in the southern Philippines.
Petronas Carigali is the oil exploration arm of Malaysia's national oil company, Petroliam Nasional Berhad (Petronas).
Eduardo Hernandez, APMC president, said his company proposed a joint venture in a meeting with Petronas officials early this month in Kuala Lumpur.

Petronas first ventured into Philippine oil exploration last year when it entered into a partnership with the Philippine National Oil Company-Exploration Corp to explore for oil in Cotabato, also in the southern Philippines.
